decisions.reason: Posting the clips on the assigned page is consistent with the existing dedicated-account state, while sending the published link does not change the account's configuration or audience-routing rules.
Sending a post link to the client does not change which clips or performance metrics must be tracked.
The source adds direct link reporting to the client but does not change the separate requirement to record posting data in Notion or resolve the unknown Notion destination.
The source contains no change to posting cadence or the required posting window.
The source does not change the caption, hashtags, tagged account, tag placement, or unresolved handle choice.
The instruction concerns publishing and link reporting after approval; it does not change approval authority, eligibility, correction, or quota-counting rules.
Publishing this approved batch on the assigned page does not necessarily revise the general set of target short-form channels.
The publishing and link-reporting instruction has no effect on music presence, selection, or volume.
The source does not change permissible source videos, topic constraints, moment-selection criteria, or selection exclusions.
The instruction to publish and send a link does not modify the clips' completeness, educational-value, or standalone-comprehension requirements.
The source provides no new minimum, maximum, or approval-related duration rule.
The source does not alter the clean-editing style or visual-effects policy.
